name: Jobab
overview: Jobab was a male member of the tribe of Benjamin, identified specifically as the son of Elpaal. His mention in Scripture is brief and focused on his lineage, with no additional notes or details about his life or character.
namesAndTitles: The name Jobab means 'howler' and is a proper name recorded in Scripture. There is no indication that this name was given by God, but it is noted in 1 Chronicles 8:18.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Jobab as the son of Elpaal. Beyond this direct paternal relationship, no other family connections are documented in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Jobab's significance lies primarily in his genealogical placement within the tribe of Benjamin, serving as a link in the genealogical records preserved in 1 Chronicles. His mention helps to trace the lineage and heritage of the tribe, which is important for understanding the broader biblical narrative of Israel's tribes and their descendants.
